read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.read_rule: logits - log(train64 per-column class prior), argmax per column, keep the columns of the requested colour, average their x, bin to left/middle/right/unknown
read_code.prior_source: train64 column labels only; fit labels are never used in the prior
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.main_denominator: all 32 fit rounds; a failed, extra-byte or invalid round is counted, never filtered
criteria.stability_rule: first-round correct rounds that become wrong <= max(1, 0.10 * first-round correct)
criteria.correction_protocol: first pass on fit; for every first-pass error release the correct answer and take 8 Adam updates at the feedback lr; re-ask all 32 once
criteria.control_arm: same trained subject, same re-ask, zero parameter updates and zero state writes; state digest before == after
criteria.feedback_gain: learned second-pass fit accuracy minus control second-pass fit accuracy
criteria.not_identifiable_rule: if first-pass fit errors < 4, correction and feedback gain are recorded as not_identifiable_by_design
criteria.recovery: save the trained bundle, reload in an independent process, re-ask all 32; outputs must be byte-identical
criteria.read_accuracy: recorded, not gated: the frozen calibrated read gives fit 32/32 and train 61/64

scope: expression positive control only: the frozen four-way read enters the byte path as a fixed code; no subject-wide training, no content-conditioned binding claim, no parent claim

price_measured.note: adopted cap is the price curve times 1.1, far below the design ceiling 600; price used 5 in-memory engineering updates and wrote no checkpoint

authorization.note: implementation, zero-update smoke and price are complete; formal training is not authorized and run mode refuses while status is not frozen

source_pin_note: post-price edits only: added the data_digest report field, merged a nested gradient finite-check guard, removed an unused import and ran black at line-length 100; the smoke/price code path and all measured unit costs are unchanged
